{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|arg= global

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Returns array with all items assigned to the [[handgunWeapon]] except magazines. Use [[handgunMagazine]] command for the latter. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

|s1= [[handgunItems]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] - [silencer, laserpointer/flashlight, optics, bipod]

|x1= <sqf>
handgunItems player;
/*
[
	"muzzle_snds_L",	// silencer
	"",					// laser
	"",					// optics
	""					// bipod
]
*/
</sqf>

|seealso= [[addHandgunItem]] [[removeHandgunItem]] [[removeAllHandgunItems]] [[weaponAccessories]] [[weaponAccessoriesCargo]] [[primaryWeaponItems]] [[secondaryWeaponItems]] [[weaponsItems]] [[binocularItems]] [[weaponsItemsCargo]]
